name: Decision checks (OpenRouter Decisions API)
description: Optional typed decision checks through the OpenRouter Decisions API (default model typesafe/jev-1.13) that answer narrow questions about claim grounding, report prose fidelity and knowledge-ingest records. Uses the member's OpenRouter key (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, from the environment or integrations.decisions.env_file). Every request is pinned to zero data retention.
egress_note: Sends claims, finding text and bounded source excerpts to OpenRouter and the serving provider (TypeSafe, US, for the default model) under zero-data-retention routing. Never used in sensitive mode or for cases that have not opted in.
risk_note: Decision signals are classifications, never evidence, verification or corroboration. They can only lower confidence, add review flags or route records to a lead layer; they never raise confidence or set a verdict.
